en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large Eastern Orthodox-style cathedral with a dominant central dome and several smaller domes, all topped with crosses. The building has tall arched windows, heavy masonry, and a broad stairway leading up to the main entrance. It is surrounded by a landscaped square with paths, small trees, and shrubs. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century photograph reproduced on cardstock, with a wide blank margin typical for vintage postcards.
